acxiom.note: B2B marketing data broker — removal is a suppression election and Acxiom publishes no public person listing, so there is nothing public to verify against.

advancedbackgroundchecks.note: AdvancedBackgroundChecks search is JS/bot-gated; its profile pages are indexed.

beenverified.note: BeenVerified walls its own search behind Cloudflare/login flows; its public profile pages are indexed, so verification reads the search index.

checkpeople.note: CheckPeople search is JS/bot-walled; its listing pages are indexed.

clustrmaps.note: ClustrMaps is aggressively bot-walled (Cloudflare); its address/person pages are indexed.

cocofinder.note: Cocofinder search is JS-driven; its profile pages are indexed.

corelogic.note: Property-data broker selling to businesses — no public person listing; removal is a suppression request.

data-axle-infousa.note: B2B marketing data broker — removal is suppression inside its business database; no public person listing exists.

epsilon.note: B2B marketing data broker — suppression-based removal via its DSR portal; no public person listing exists to check.

epsilon-conversant.note: Ad-tech (Conversant) — opt-out is a cookie/device suppression; no public person listing exists to check.

equifax.note: Credit bureau — opt-outs are marketing-prescreen suppressions; Equifax has no public person listing to verify against.

experian.note: Credit bureau — opt-outs are marketing-prescreen suppressions; Experian has no public person listing to verify against.

familytreenow.note: FamilyTreeNow search is form-driven with bot checks; its record pages are indexed.

fastpeoplesearch.note: Direct: /name/{first}-{last} is documented in Bazzell's Intel Techniques OSINT book and multiple open-source scrapers, and results are server-rendered person cards. The site sometimes answers 'Access Denied' to datacenter IPs, which degrades to unknown.

infotracer.note: InfoTracer search is a members-area JS flow; its public record pages are indexed.

instant-checkmate.note: Instant Checkmate search is JS/bot-walled; its public pages are indexed, so the index is the fetchable evidence.

intelius.note: Intelius (PeopleConnect) gates search behind JS/paywall flows; its public listing pages are indexed.

lexisnexis-risk-solutions.note: Risk-data broker — removal runs through its consumer disclosure/opt-out process; no public people-search listing exists.

liveramp.note: B2B identity/ad-data platform — rights requests are suppression-based; LiveRamp publishes no public person listing.

mylife.note: MyLife profile pages are indexed; the site's own search is JS-driven and bot-checked.

neighborwho.note: NeighborWho search is JS-driven; its property/person pages surface in the search index.

neustar-transunion.note: B2B identity data (Neustar, a TransUnion company) — suppression-based removal; no public person listing exists.

nuwber.note: Nuwber refuses many server networks outright; its profile pages appear in the search index.

oracle-data-cloud.note: B2B ad-data platform — opt-out is a cookie/ID suppression; Oracle Data Cloud publishes no public person listing.

peekyou.note: PeekYou profiles are heavily indexed; its own search is JS-driven.

peoplefinders.note: PeopleFinders search is JS-driven with CAPTCHA gates; its listing pages are indexed, so verification reads the search index.

peoplelooker.note: PeopleLooker (BeenVerified network) walls its search; its public pages are indexed.

publicrecordsnow.note: PublicRecordsNow search is JS/bot-walled; its result pages are indexed.

radaris.note: Radaris is Cloudflare-walled from datacenter IPs; its profile pages are well indexed.

searchpeoplefree.note: SearchPeopleFree results are JS-rendered; its profile pages are indexed.

searchquarry.note: SearchQuarry search is JS-driven; its record pages appear in the search index.

social-catfish.note: Social Catfish search sits behind JS and paywall steps; its public pages are indexed.

spokeo.note: Profile pages sit behind Cloudflare and are JS-rendered, but Spokeo listings are heavily indexed — the search index is the fetchable evidence.

thatsthem.note: ThatsThem search is JS-driven; its profile pages are indexed, so verification uses the search index.

transunion.note: Credit bureau — opt-outs are marketing-prescreen suppressions; TransUnion has no public person listing to verify against.

truepeoplesearch.note: Direct: /results?name= is confirmed in live URLs (webcompat issue #226143, uBlock uAssets #27839) and opt-out research notes, and result cards are in the served HTML (not a JS-only app). The site runs PerimeterX bot protection, so a walled fetch degrades to unknown — never a wrong verdict.

truthfinder.note: TruthFinder search runs behind JS and bot walls; its report/listing pages surface in the search index.

usphonebook.note: USPhoneBook pages are indexed; the site's own search is a JS flow behind bot checks.

voterrecords.note: VoterRecords search is form/JS-driven; its record pages are indexed.

whitepages.note: Whitepages search is a JS app behind bot checks; its listing pages are indexed, so verification reads the search index.
